standard: No known unresolved blocking defects; reproducible builds; reviewed safety-critical changes; evidence for failure recovery and supported operating conditions. Passing unit tests alone is insufficient.

gates.criterion: Claude independently reviews final candidate 1dddadbd1bb45e0a7bb1ce046ab2362e37ca0625 and all introduced execution, authority, bank, storage and upgrade changes; resolves G009/G010/G011 findings and the new completion proposal; integrates only after supported CI passes.

Actual supervised IB paper acceptance remains required: late/partial fills, cancel/fill races, unknown intents, smoke crash cleanup, restart, margin/buying-power and dedicated/allocation cash semantics. Qualify the implemented cost/gap reserves and permanent indexed trade history against real broker reports.

Independent statistical review and prospectively agreed, adequately powered false-positive and power qualification across correlated/staggered histories, horizons, selection and failure/retry exposure. The bounded synthetic power pilot is diagnostic only. Production thresholds must not be relaxed.

Qualify source revisions, point-in-time membership, delisting/corporate-action economics, supported calendar/adapter timestamps, true borrow/recall economics and intrabar execution. Sparse replay with whole-bar delay rounding is an approximation.

The implemented manual/supervised/autonomous controls and opt-in daily bank require independent policy review and actual paper qualification. Validate complete policy eligibility/expiry/retirement, regime transitions, cash fallback, authority expiry/cancellation and one-use approvals; no automatic strategy promotion or live-money authority.

Digest-pinned Python/Gateway images, frozen Debian snapshot, locked Python builds and local crash/storage/backup tests are implemented. External deployment qualification still requires supervisor recovery, physical power-loss/storage behavior, complete restore/reconciliation, actual alert delivery, architecture coverage and long-duration resource-growth soak.
Independent review of generated-code isolation and deployment permissions, resource exhaustion, supported native architectures and syscall boundaries. Existing exploit regressions remain mandatory.
